summary: Parses a NUL-terminated hex digit string (digits and a-f/A-F) into an integer by ASCII-normalized base-16 accumulation. Each character is loaded, letter digits are normalized (lowercase 'a'-'f' subtract 39, uppercase 'A'-'F' subtract 7), and the character is folded into the running result via the accumulation formula v3 + 16 * (result + 268435453). Returns the accumulated value. Used by LocaleEnumProc and three sibling parser helpers in the same module.

local_names.v3: current character, normalized into a digit value range

operations.description: Iterate over the characters of the input string a1, loading v3 = *a1 and advancing the pointer each pass, until the NUL terminator is reached
Initialize the accumulated result to 0 before the first character; each iteration loads the next character from the advancing string pointer
Break the loop when the loaded character is zero (NUL terminator)
Normalize the character: if it is a lowercase hex letter (97..102, 'a'-'f') subtract 39; else if it is an uppercase hex letter (65..70, 'A'-'F') subtract 7; decimal digits pass through unchanged
Accumulate the normalized character into the running result as a base-16 shift: result = v3 + 16 * (result + 268435453)
Return the accumulated parse result; invoked by LocaleEnumProc (0x0058FFEC) and the sibling parser helpers sub_590246, sub_59033A and sub_59045F

unresolved: The constant 268435453 in the accumulation is the compiled encoding of a '-48' digit bias; the reconstruction preserves the packet spelling and does not claim the literal's source-level meaning
Whether the callers feed prefixed or signed hex strings is not evident from this function alone
